'''2008 Albany Mini-Open''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG mini-open organized by [[Matt Sokol]] for Saturday 9 August 2008 at the Zombie Planet store in Albany, New York, with one bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]] as its prize.<ref name="sf-22129-319273">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=319273#p319273 ALBANY MINI-OPEN], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023037/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22129 Internet Archive]</ref> Only two players came, Sokol and [[Aaron Kingery]], and Sokol asked the Players Committee to reschedule the event for September.<ref name="sf-22129-323275">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=323275#p323275 ALBANY MINI-OPEN], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023037/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22129 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Zombie Planet, Albany, New York<ref name="sf-22129-319273" /><ref name="sf-22141-319620">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=319620#p319620 Albany Mini Open], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (30 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125193810/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22141.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 9 August 2008<ref name="sf-22129-319273" />
* '''Time:''' 11 am<ref name="sf-22129-319273" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10, to go to a gift certificate at the store; the top two would split it 70/30<ref name="sf-22129-319273" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Matt Sokol]]<ref name="sf-22129-319273" />
* '''Prize:''' one bye to Day 2 of the World Championship<ref name="sf-22129-319273" />

== Organization ==

In June 2008 Sokol asked how to hold a mini-open in Albany. He needed only the approval of the store, which had an entire upstairs room of card tables.<ref name="sf-21387-308456">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308456#p308456 Question], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191506/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21387.html Internet Archive]</ref> He announced the event on 29 July 2008, apologizing for the short notice.<ref name="sf-22129-319273" /> The next day he added that he and Kingery would give $100, $50 each, to any player from out of town who came and won.<ref name="sf-22129-319325">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=319325#p319325 ALBANY MINI-OPEN], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (30 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023037/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22129 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

On the day of the event Sokol wrote that only he and Kingery had shown up, and asked whether the Players Committee would let them reschedule for September as the last big event before Worlds.<ref name="sf-22129-323275" /> Cedric (simone89) replied that he was "99.99% sure" the new date would be 20 September 2008.<ref name="sf-22129-330034">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330034#p330034 ALBANY MINI-OPEN], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023037/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22129 Internet Archive]</ref> His list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids, posted on 29 August 2008, gave "August 9th Albany Open Qualifier" with no name against it.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
